title: Oracle-Robust Online Alignment for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.20457v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study online alignment of large language models under misspecified preference feedback, where the observed preference oracle deviates from an ideal but unknown ground-truth oracle. The online LLM alignment problem is a bi-level reinforcement problem due to the coupling between data collection and policy updates. Recently, the problem has been reduced to a tractable single-level objective in the SAIL (Self-Improving Efficient Online Alignment) framework. In this paper, we introduce a pointwise oracle uncertainty set in this problem and formulate an oracle-robust online alignment objective as a worst-case optimization problem. For log-linear policies, we show that this robust objective admits an exact closed-form decomposition into the original loss function plus an explicit sensitivity penalty. translated_title: 大语言模型的预言机鲁棒在线对齐
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在偏好反馈被错误设定情形下的大语言模型在线对齐问题，其中观测到的偏好预言机与理想但未知的真实预言机之间存在偏差。由于数据收集与策略更新之间的耦合，在线大语言模型对齐问题本质上是一个双层强化学习问题。近期，SAIL（自我提升的高效在线对齐）框架已将该问题约化为一个易于处理的单层目标。本文在该问题中引入了逐点预言机不确定性集合，并将预言机鲁棒的在线对齐目标表述为一个最坏情况优化问题。对于对数线性策略，我们证明该鲁棒目标可以精确地闭式分解为原始损失函数加上一个显式的敏感度惩罚项。在有限响应的对数线性设定下，我们针对所得的弱凸目标提出了投影随机复合更新方法……
tldr: 本文针对偏好反馈预言机可能存在偏差的大语言模型在线对齐问题，提出最坏情况鲁棒优化目标，并证明该鲁棒目标可精确分解为原始损失加显式敏感度惩罚项，进而设计了投影随机复合更新算法进行求解。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates an oracle-robust online alignment objective for LLMs under misspecified preference feedback as a worst-case optimization, proves it admits an exact closed-form decomposition into the original loss plus an explicit sensitivity penalty, and develops projected stochastic composite updates to solve the resulting weakly convex objective.
